Name: Migdol
ModernLocation: Unknown; on the west shore of the Red Sea, Egypt
Description: One of the stations on Israel's wilderness journey, named in the Numbers 33 itinerary. A landmark named beside Pi-hahiroth in the crossing account; the same name later marks an Egyptian frontier town. No further detail is recorded beyond the journey account.
BiblicalSignificance: The wilderness stations trace the route God led Israel from Egypt to the Plains of Moab.
